plain: To pass down to someone else, as a duty or power

webster.text: To roll down; to pour or flow with windings.

more.text: To move from one person to another; to deliver over, or from one possessor to a successor.
Literally, to roll down; hence, to pass from one to another; to fall by succession from one possessor to his successor.

example.quote: Even the management of foreign negotiations will naturally devolve upon him, according to general principles concerted with the Senate, and subject to their final concurrence.
